name: Night Resort
coordinates: three.js / glTF: +Y up, play area x,z ∈ [-50, 50] (Blender x, -y). GLB node positions are already in this space.

heightfield.note: heights[r][c] = terrain height (three y) at three x = -50 + c, z = -50 + r (1 m grid, 101×101)

environment.note: GLB contains no light objects. Emissive materials (windows, bulbs, lamp heads, aurora) are in the GLB; create the listed lights in the game engine.
